scope: Eighty-two actual original source-color and paper observations cover seven display scales, four paper sizes, changing even/odd window heights, one-page and multiple-page documents, and normal/relative source fonts. Exact white paper edges and source shade positions are literal independently decoded observations. Full-width unpainted native capture strips explicitly leave a lower continuation edge unobserved. Foreground glyph antialiasing and shade-width parity are separate incomplete contracts.
